The volume examines Finnish stage art in both aesthetics and practice, combining critical reflections on drama’s purpose with intimate psychological profiles of actors and discussions of theatre’s organization and craft. The opening of this collection declares a mission to expand Finland’s sparse theatre literature, especially through psychologically acute actor studies, while also justifying practical essays on theatre as an institution.
